items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And was, Bill says, was French the only language you could read in?

ctx.x: Do you still read very much or not?
Well, I can't read no more, Mr. Russell.
Because of your eyes now. Now where are all of your books? Are they still over at your other home? All of your books that you had?
